title: THE BREAK
entrance_text: The signal is out. Across Aethoria, System interfaces are flickering. Class ratings cycling. Death-record clocks paused. Something is wrong with the machine. Something you put there.

root.text: The Fracture Core is exposed. Raw dimensional energy bleeds from the wound in reality. The System terminal behind you is still running the break signal. All you have to do now is push it through.

options.label: Amplify the signal through the Core -- end the System
Take a moment -- warn anyone who will listen about what comes next
Dismiss the Breakers -- face the System alone

last_preparations.text: You take sixty seconds. You transmit what you know about the Fracture's true origin to every receiver in range. The System terminal pulses. Time is running out.

options.label: Hesitate one last time -- is there another way?

the_break.text:
You push through.

The System breaks.

Not a loud sound. A silence -- the silence of ten thousand interface panels going dark simultaneously across a continent. Class ratings: offline. Alignment tracking: offline. Life token registers: offline. Death records: sealed.

The Fracture wound pulses once, massively, and closes. The tear that started everything three years ago knits shut.

You are standing in a cave. It is just a cave now.

options.label: Walk out into whatever world comes next

victory_destroy.text:
The world without the System is not the world before the Fracture. That world is gone. What exists now is something new -- chaotic, frightening, and genuinely free.

In Verath, the Crown scrambles without System backing. The Shadow Network publishes everything. It causes riots in fourteen cities.

People die who would not have died under the System. People live who would have been erased.

You walk out of the dungeon into morning light. No status display over your head. No class rating. No alignment score. No life counter.

Just you, and the world, and whatever you choose to do next.

[ END -- BREAKER PATH ]
[ The System is gone. The story is just beginning. ]
